about.en: AVL is the token of Avalon Labs (Avalon Finance), a Bitcoin-focused on-chain lending platform offering BTC-backed loans, the USDa stablecoin and yield products across many chains. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x5c8d0c48810fd37a0a824d074ee290e64f7a8fa2, with project deployments on BNB Chain and Merlin Chain.
